versos.grego: Τοιγαροῦν καὶ ἡμεῖς, τοσοῦτον ἔχοντες περικείμενον ἡμῖν νέφος μαρτύρων, ὄγκον ἀποθέμενοι πάντα καὶ τὴν εὐπερίστατον ἁμαρτίαν, δι’ ὑπομονῆς τρέχωμεν τὸν προκείμενον ἡμῖν ἀγῶνα,

controles.web: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
controles.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
controles.livre: Portanto nós também, posto que estamos rodeados por uma tão grande nuvem de testemunhas, deixemos toda sobrecarga, e o pecado envolvente, e corramos com paciência a corrida que nos está proposta,

versos.grego: ἀφορῶντες εἰς τὸν τῆς πίστεως ἀρχηγὸν καὶ τελειωτὴν Ἰησοῦν, ὃς ἀντὶ τῆς προκειμένης αὐτῷ χαρᾶς ὑπέμεινεν σταυρὸν αἰσχύνης καταφρονήσας, ἐν δεξιᾷ τε τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ Θεοῦ κεκάθικεν.

controles.web: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
controles.kjv: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
controles.livre: olhando para Jesus, Autor e aperfeiçoador da fé. Ele, pela alegria que lhe estava proposta, suportou a cruz, desprezando a humilhação, e se assentou à direita do trono de Deus.

versos.grego: ἀναλογίσασθε γὰρ τὸν τοιαύτην ὑπομεμενηκότα ὑπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν εἰς ἑαυτὸν ἀντιλογίαν, ἵνα μὴ κάμητε ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν ἐκλυόμενοι.

controles.web: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
controles.kjv: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
controles.livre: Considerai, pois, aquele que suportou tal hostilidade dos pecadores contra si mesmo, para que não fiqueis exaustos, nem vossas almas se debilitem.

versos.grego: Οὔπω μέχρις αἵματος ἀντικατέστητε πρὸς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἀνταγωνιζόμενοι,

controles.web: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;
controles.kjv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
controles.livre: Enquanto lutais contra o pecado, ainda não resististes ao sangue,  )

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκλέλησθε τῆς παρακλήσεως, ἥτις ὑμῖν ὡς υἱοῖς διαλέγεται Υἱέ μου, μὴ ὀλιγώρει παιδείας Κυρίου, μηδὲ ἐκλύου ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐλεγχόμενος·

controles.web: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children,  “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
controles.kjv: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
controles.livre: mas já vos esquecestes do encorajamento que ele fala convosco como a filhos: Meu filho, não desprezes a disciplina do Senhor, nem te canses de ser reprendido por ele;

versos.grego: ὃν γὰρ ἀγαπᾷ Κύριος παιδεύει, μαστιγοῖ δὲ πάντα υἱὸν ὃν παραδέχεται.

controles.web: For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.”
controles.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
controles.livre: pois o Senhor disciplina a quem ama, e açoita a todo filho a quem recebe.

versos.grego: εἰς παιδείαν ὑπομένετε· ὡς υἱοῖς ὑμῖν προσφέρεται ὁ Θεός· τίς γὰρ υἱὸς ὃν οὐ παιδεύει πατήρ;

controles.web: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
controles.kjv: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
controles.livre: É para a disciplina que suportais. Deus vos trata como filhos; pois que filho há a quem o pai não discipline?

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ χωρίς ἐστε παιδείας, ἧς μέτοχοι γεγόνασιν πάντες, ἄρα νόθοι καὶ οὐχ υἱοί ἐστε.

controles.web: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not children.
controles.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
controles.livre: Mas se estais sem disciplina, da qual todos são feitos participantes, sois então ilegítimos, e não filhos.

versos.grego: εἶτα τοὺς μὲν τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν πατέρας εἴχομεν παιδευτὰς καὶ ἐνετρεπόμεθα· οὐ πολὺ μᾶλλον ὑποταγησόμεθα τῷ Πατρὶ τῶν πνευμάτων καὶ ζήσομεν;

controles.web: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?
controles.kjv: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
controles.livre: Além disso, tivemos os pais de nossa carne como disciplinadores, e nós os respeitávamos. Por acaso não nos sujeitaremos muito mais ao Pai dos espíritos, a fim de vivermos?

versos.grego: οἱ μὲν γὰρ πρὸς ὀλίγας ἡμέρας κατὰ τὸ δοκοῦν αὐτοῖς ἐπαίδευον, ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τὸ συμφέρον εἰς τὸ μεταλαβεῖν τῆς ἁγιότητος αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
controles.kjv: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
controles.livre: Pois eles nos disciplinavam, por um pouco de tempo, como bem lhes parecia; mas Deus  nos disciplina para proveito nosso ,a fim de sermos participantes da sua santidade.

versos.grego: πᾶσα μὲν παιδεία πρὸς μὲν τὸ παρὸν οὐ δοκεῖ χαρᾶς εἶναι ἀλλὰ λύπης, ὕστερον δὲ καρπὸν εἰρηνικὸν τοῖς δι’ αὐτῆς γεγυμνασμένοις ἀποδίδωσιν δικαιοσύνης.

controles.web: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.
controles.kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
controles.livre: De fato, enquanto presente, nenhuma disciplina parece ser motivo de alegria, mas sim de sofrimento; mas depois produz fruto pacífico de justiça aos que por ela foram exercitados.

versos.grego: Διὸ τὰς παρειμένας χεῖρας καὶ τὰ παραλελυμένα γόνατα ἀνορθώσατε,

controles.web: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
controles.kjv: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
controles.livre: Portanto, levantai as mãos cansadas e os joelhos frouxos,

versos.grego: καὶ τροχιὰς ὀρθὰς ποιεῖτε τοῖς ποσὶν ὑμῶν, ἵνα μὴ τὸ χωλὸν ἐκτραπῇ, ἰαθῇ δὲ μᾶλλον.

controles.web: and make straight paths for your feet, so that which is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
controles.kjv: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
controles.livre: e “fazei caminhos retos para os vossos pés”, para que o que está manco não se desloque, mas sim, que sare.

versos.grego: Εἰρήνην διώκετε μετὰ πάντων, καὶ τὸν ἁγιασμόν, οὗ χωρὶς οὐδεὶς ὄψεται τὸν Κύριον,

controles.web: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
controles.kjv: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
controles.livre: Buscai a paz com todos, e a santificação, sem a qual ninguém verá o Senhor.

versos.grego: ἐπισκοποῦντες μή τις ὑστερῶν ἀπὸ τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Θεοῦ, μή τις ῥίζα πικρίας ἄνω φύουσα ἐνοχλῇ καὶ διὰ ταύτης μιανθῶσιν οἱ πολλοί,

controles.web: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;
controles.kjv: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
controles.livre: Vigiai com empenho para que ninguém perca de receber da graça de Deus; para não acontecer que alguma raiz de amargura brote, seja incômoda, e muitos sejam contaminados por ela.

versos.grego: μή τις πόρνος ἢ βέβηλος ὡς Ἠσαῦ, ὃς ἀντὶ βρώσεως μιᾶς ἀπέδετο τὰ πρωτοτόκια ἑαυτοῦ.

controles.web: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
controles.kjv: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
controles.livre: Ninguém seja pecador sexual, ou profano como Esaú, que por uma refeição vendeu o seu direito de primogenitura.

versos.grego: ἴστε γὰρ ὅτι καὶ μετέπειτα θέλων κληρονομῆσαι τὴν εὐλογίαν ἀπεδοκιμάσθη, μετανοίας γὰρ τόπον οὐχ εὗρεν, καίπερ μετὰ δακρύων ἐκζητήσας αὐτήν.

controles.web: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
controles.kjv: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
controles.livre: Pois vós sabeis que depois, quando ele quis herdar a benção, foi rejeitado, porque não achou lugar para arrependimento, ainda que com lágrimas o tenha buscado.

versos.grego: Οὐ γὰρ προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ καὶ κεκαυμένῳ πυρὶ καὶ γνόφῳ καὶ ζόφῳ καὶ θυέλλῃ

controles.web: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
controles.kjv: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
controles.livre: Porque não chegastes a algo palpável, aceso com fogo, e à escuridão, às trevas, e à tempestade;

versos.grego: καὶ σάλπιγγος ἤχῳ καὶ φωνῇ ῥημάτων, ἧς οἱ ἀκούσαντες παρῃτήσαντο μὴ προστεθῆναι αὐτοῖς λόγον·

controles.web: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
controles.kjv: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
controles.livre: ao som da trombeta, e à voz das palavras, que os que a ouviam, rogaram que não mais se lhes falasse palavra alguma;

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔφερον γὰρ τὸ διαστελλόμενον Κἂν θηρίον θίγῃ τοῦ ὄρους, λιθοβοληθήσεται·

controles.web: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”;
controles.kjv: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
controles.livre: (pois não podiam suportar o que lhes era ordenado: Se até um animal tocar o monte, seja apedrejado.

versos.grego: καί, οὕτω φοβερὸν ἦν τὸ φανταζόμενον, Μωϋσῆς εἶπεν Ἔκφοβός εἰμι καὶ ἔντρομος·

controles.web: and so fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
controles.kjv: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
controles.livre: E a visão era tão terrível, que Moisés disse: Estou assombrado e tremendo).

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ προσεληλύθατε Σιὼν ὄρει καὶ πόλει Θεοῦ ζῶντος, Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἐπουρανίῳ, καὶ μυριάσιν ἀγγέλων, πανηγύρει

controles.web: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
controles.kjv: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
controles.livre: Mas vós chegastes ao monte Sião, à cidade do Deus vivo, a Jerusalém celestial, e aos muitos milhares de anjos,

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκκλησίᾳ πρωτοτόκων ἀπογεγραμμένων ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ Κριτῇ Θεῷ πάντων, καὶ πνεύμασι δικαίων τετελειωμένων,

controles.web: to the general assembly and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
controles.kjv: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
controles.livre: à universal congregação e igreja dos primogênitos inscritos nos Céus, e a Deus, o Juiz de todos, e aos espíritos dos justos já aperfeiçoados;

versos.grego: καὶ διαθήκης νέας μεσίτῃ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ αἵματι ῥαντισμοῦ κρεῖττον λαλοῦντι παρὰ τὸν Ἄβελ.

controles.web: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
controles.kjv: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
controles.livre: e a Jesus, o Mediador de um Novo Testamento, e ao sangue da aspersão, que fala melhor coisa que o de Abel.

versos.grego: Βλέπετε μὴ παραιτήσησθε τὸν λαλοῦντα· εἰ γὰρ ἐκεῖνοι οὐκ ἐξέφυγον ἐπὶ γῆς παραιτησάμενοι τὸν χρηματίζοντα, πολὺ μᾶλλον ἡμεῖς οἱ τὸν ἀπ’ οὐρανῶν ἀποστρεφόμενοι·

controles.web: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
controles.kjv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
controles.livre: Tende o cuidado de não rejeitardes ao que fala. Pois, se não escaparam aqueles que rejeitaram ao que os advertia divinamente na terra, muito menos nós, se nos desviarmos daquele que nos adverte dos Céus.

versos.grego: οὗ ἡ φωνὴ τὴν γῆν ἐσάλευσεν τότε, νῦν δὲ ἐπήγγελται λέγων Ἔτι ἅπαξ ἐγὼ σείσω οὐ μόνον τὴν γῆν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸν οὐρανόν.

controles.web: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
controles.kjv: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
controles.livre: A voz dele fez a terra tremer naquela ocasião, mas agora prometeu, dizendo: Ainda uma vez farei tremer não somente a terra, mas também o Céu.

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ Ἔτι ἅπαξ δηλοῖ τὴν τῶν σαλευομένων μετάθεσιν ὡς πεποιημένων, ἵνα μείνῃ τὰ μὴ σαλευόμενα.

controles.web: This phrase, “Yet once more”, signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
controles.kjv: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
controles.livre: Esta expressão ,“Ainda uma vez”, mostra a remoção das coisas abaladas, como coisas criadas, para que as inabaláveis permaneçam.

versos.grego: Διὸ βασιλείαν ἀσάλευτον παραλαμβάνοντες ἔχωμεν χάριν, δι’ ἧς λατρεύωμεν εὐαρέστως τῷ Θεῷ, μετὰ εὐλαβείας καὶ δέους·

controles.web: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
controles.kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
controles.livre: Por isso, já que recebemos um Reino inabalável, mantenhamos a graça,  e por ela sirvamos a Deus de maneira que o agrade, com devoção e temor,

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν πῦρ καταναλίσκον.

controles.web: for our God is a consuming fire.
controles.kjv: For our God is a consuming fire.
controles.livre: pois o nosso Deus é um fogo consumidor.
